description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'diff' functionalities within a Git project. It includes test cases for various 'git diff-files' options, validates output formats, and manipulates files to set up testing scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with specific commands.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares expected and actual diff outputs.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the given output is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of all tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.
